contract_snapshot.interface: A pytest module using the fixtures app, client and helper login from tests/conftest.py and helper api. Seed one employee and one asset through the API (Authorization: Bearer test-api-key). Assert: as admin (admin@firma.cz) GET /admin/assets, /admin/assets/new, /admin/assets/<id>, /admin/assets/<id>/edit, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/employees/jan@firma.cz, /admin/audit all return 200 and contain the tag NB-0001 where the asset is listed; as employee (jan@firma.cz) GET / returns 200 and /admin/assets returns 403; GET /auth/login while anonymous returns 200 and contains 'Přihlásit'; unknown token GET /handovers/confirm/12345 as jan returns 410. At least 6 assertions across 3 test functions; no mocks; do not modify any other file.
